title: Internal: Opening Personal Savings Accounts
summary: This document provides the step-by-step procedure to open a personal savings account at Rho-Bank, including eligibility checks (identity verified, at least one active checking account, fewer than 5 savings accounts, no collections/negative balances, checking tenure ≥14 days) and required agent tool actions open_bank_account_4821 and transfer_funds_between_bank_accounts_7291. If the customer declines funding now, they have 30 days to fund the account or it will be closed.
faqs: What are the eligibility requirements to open a personal savings account?
